name: scene3d_add_keyframes
description: Append Motion camera keyframes by take. Pause-free cut: cut:true + timestamp>0 + cutFrom; legacy cuts without cutFrom hold the prior pose. Max 60/take, 240/path. @see guides_get('scene3d')

globalEasing.description: Default keyframe easing: smooth, linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out. Default smooth.

keyframes.description: Keyframes to append, in order. Every take of the sequence in one call. Max 60 per take, 240 across the path.

cameraId.description: Saved camera id copied verbatim from scene3d_state cameras. Never synthesize a __camera_N__ placeholder; when no saved camera was returned, omit cameraId and send position + target. Explicit fields override.

cut.description: True starts a hard cut. New cuts require timestamp>0 and cutFrom.

cutFrom.description: Outgoing full camera snapshot immediately before a new cut.

focalDistance.description: Required with quaternion; forbidden with target.

quaternion.description: Outgoing orientation; requires focalDistance; alternative to target.

target.description: Outgoing look-at; derives focus, so omit focalDistance.

easing.description: Per-keyframe easing: smooth, linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out. Default globalEasing.

focalDistance.description: Focus plane distance in world units. Mutually exclusive with target. For a focus pull, send it without target. Default 5 otherwise.

fov.description: Field of view (deg). Default derived from focalLength.

position.description: {x,y,z} camera position in world units. Keep it outside object footprints and geometry from scene3d_state; never place a close-up camera inside the subject or set. Required unless cameraId is set.

shotId.description: Take this keyframe belongs to. Defaults to the top-level shotId; set it per keyframe to author several takes in one call.

target.description: {x,y,z} look-at point in world units; derives both orientation and focus distance. Aim at actual subject geometry: a SOMA actor is about 0.8u tall, so its face is roughly base y + 0.65–0.75u, not a height in metres. Mutually exclusive with quaternion and focalDistance.

timestamp.description: Local time (s) in the shot. Omit to auto-append after the last keyframe.

shotId.description: Default take to append to (scene3d_add_shots / scene3d_state). Required once the sequence has more than one, unless every keyframe carries its own.
